description: Unit tests for TalkDirectiveParser in the OpenClawKit project, verifying parsing behavior of directives within text, including recognized and unrecognized fields, extended options, and handling of whitespace and unknown keys.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveTests
classes.description: Test suite for TalkDirectiveParser parsing logic.

methods.name: testParsesDirectiveAndStripsLine
methods.description: Verifies correct parsing of a directive with voice and once fields, and that the line is stripped.

methods.name: testIgnoresNonDirective
methods.description: Checks that non-directive lines are not parsed as directives and are returned as-is.

methods.name: testKeepsDirectiveLineIfNoRecognizedFields
methods.description: Ensures lines with unknown directive fields do not produce a directive.

methods.name: testParsesExtendedOptions
methods.description: Validates parsing of extended directive options such as voice_id, model_id, rate, stability, etc.

methods.name: testSkipsLeadingEmptyLinesWhenParsingDirective
methods.description: Tests that leading empty lines do not interfere with directive parsing.

methods.name: testTracksUnknownKeys
methods.description: Checks that unrecognized keys are tracked properly in unknownKeys.
